newsitem.title: USA: Castle Energy increases share buyback.
newsitem.headline: Castle Energy increases share buyback.

text.p: Castle Energy Corp said Thursday it had increased its share repurchase authorization to 1.5 million shares from 1.0 million and hadextended the buyback period to the end of October from the end of April.
To date, the company has repurchased 865,700 shares, or 12.9 percent of the shares outstanding at the time it commenced the program in October 1996, Castle said.
Of the purchase cost to date, $2.0 million has been provided from borrowed funds, it said.
The company said it expects cash flow from operations will continue to provide most of the funds for share repurchases.
